result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): A sorts the settings into labelled groups (Profile, Practice and notifications), so the reminder time sits with the toggles. B puts the reminder time in the same block as the profile fields. Both separate Delete account clearly, A with a red-tinted panel after a large gap and B with its own card. A's padding is slightly roomier and its spacing a little more even, but its Save button is cut off in the screenshot, while B shows Save placed sensibly before the danger zone. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): A puts Delete account in its own red-bordered card below the main settings card, so it is clearly set apart, and Save sits with the settings it applies to. B groups related fields better with its PROFILE and PRACTICE AND NOTIFICATIONS headings, but it places the Delete account box inside the main card, which nests one box in another and separates the danger zone less clearly. Both keep labels tight to their inputs and use consistent, comfortable spacing.
